name: Paytiko for WooCommerce
author: Paytiko - Payment Orchestration Platform

sections.description:
Paytiko Orchestrating 500+ Payment Partners Via A Secure, Seamless Ecosystem

Are you searching for the best payment technology to optimize payment workflow? If yes, then Paytiko meets all your needs!

We offer a fully certified and advanced payment management software suitable for every online business, ranging from banks and payment providers to financial organizations and e-commerce companies.

Paytiko payments orchestrator plugin for WooCommerce allows you to manage all your payments flow under a single dashboard within your store

Fully PCI Certified

Focus on business growth instead of the hassle of compliance, through a fully PCI and DSS compliant and secure system.

Payments For a Digital World

With payments going online, businesses require comprehensive payment management abilities, to help to optimize, operate, and scale all types of transactions.

Paytiko is a fully certified and advanced payment orchestration software that integrates global payment providers and acquirers along with numerous transaction administration features, to bring merchants a unified payment communication, control, and management interface.

What We Offer

Services

  • Incoming Payments : Access 500+ payment providers and numerous incoming transaction tools to cater to global consumers, via local and international payment option

  • Outgoing Payments : Execute manual withdrawals and refunds effortlessly, via all integrated payment processors and methods, with corresponding detailed information

  • Payment Infrastructure : Access intricate reports, graphs, charts, and data to better understand financial standing and reconcile with processors for faster settlement of funds.

  • Turnkey Dashboard : Via 3 distinct sections, manage and organize daily monetary operations through a comprehensive yet simple interface to help increase transaction success ratios.

  • Paytiko Growth Hub : Automated machine learning, analytics, dynamic triggers, and intuitive mapping to empower real-time, data-driven payment suggestions and insights.

  • Subscription Payments : Easy subscription payment handling for merchants and clients alike – all within Paytiko’s powerful framework with Paytiko SubHub.

  • Reporting And Reconciliation : Access intricate reports, graphs, charts, and data to better understand financial standing and reconcile with processors for faster settlement of funds

  • Smart Routing : Lower the risk of declines and improve approval rates by smart redirection of payments to dependable fallback providers.

  • Pay-By-Link : Generate unique payment links and send them to end clients via SMS or email, for a hassle-free payment experience, remote sales, and invoicing.

We offer competitive packages tailored to the needs of businesses of all sizes.
Visit our pricing page to know more
